episodes.187139: Just before 3 pm a pickup truck crashed into a semi tractor trailer and both individuals in the pickup truck died due to the accident.   One individual in the semi was airlifted to a local hospital.  The accident occurred 1 mile south of Macks Inn on US Highway 20.  Small hail accumulating to 3 to 4 inches in a 30 minute time frame was believed to be a significant contributing factor in the accident according to Idaho State Police.   The Highway was shut down for 4 hours due to the accident.
episodes.187363: An upper level low pressure system offshore the Pacific Northwest produced showers across the eastern mountains throughout the day on November 5th. forecast soundings over this area indicated meager MUCAPE and decent mid-level lapse rates over the eastern mountains of Oregon in the afternoon. This provided enough support for thunderstorm development and a subsequent occurrence of a weak tornado near Canyon City, Or.

events.narrative: Approximate EF0 tornado path was less than 0.25 miles at Marysville Lane, located east-southeast of Canyon City, Oregon. One tree was uprooted in saturated soil. One manufactured home experienced roof damage, including the removal of roofing |material. An opened hay shelter also saw roofing material removed. A travel-trailer was moved several feet from its original location.
